scene_description: A modern kitchen containing a refrigerator, cooktop/oven, upper cabinets, counters, and drawers. After an initial survey, the user opens the refrigerator, separately opens both leaves of an upper cabinet, closes the refrigerator, opens a utensil drawer, and later closes the cabinet leaves and drawer.
